This T0 plan converts the approved `C-TEST-TIMEOUT-CEILING-1-4985C820` spec into two sequential tasks. **T-001 — the mechanism:** the three `package.json` scripts carry `--timeout=0`; the **82** per-test pins across six test files are removed; the four suite-running workflow jobs carry `timeout-minutes: 30`; the pin guard and the workflow guard land in `scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts`; the taught `ngrace-spec` sentence is rewritten in both trees, both `TAUGHT_RULES` token tables change from `explicit generous timeout` to `only ceiling`; `README.md:382` becomes `bun run test`; and the skill-text footprint pin is updated (`src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts` totalBytes `78384 → 78456`, the README measurement cell `78384 → 78456 UTF-8 bytes`, line total stays 866). **T-002 — the payment:** flush `F266` through the shipped parser, `xmlEscape` and canonical serializer, add its index `Entry`, mint the chartered row `C-TEST-TIMEOUT-CEILING-1-4985C820` with `Pays F266`, run `--rewrite-roots`, then land the flush-invariant and row walks and drive the faithful post-close applied-archive copy.
**Two forced scope additions beyond the spec's write-scope Constraint, declared at plan time (skill `must_do` 6).** (1) `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts` — the skill-text change necessarily moves `skillTextLines().totalBytes`, which that test pins; the spec's write-scope Constraint named neither the test nor the README measurement cell, so T-001 lands both and the plan's `ObservedWriteScope` names the test. It is a `.test.ts`, so `isModuleOwnableWritePath` is false and `change.graph-anchors-miss-write-scope` cannot fire; `src/test-support/token-accounting.ts` (module-ownable under `M-TEST-SUPPORT`) is **not** written. (2) The README measurement cell is inside the already-scoped `README.md`.
**The spec's flush projection is corrected by measurement.** The spec's `Assumptions` projected findings `7370 / 345 / 7715` after flush; driven through the shipped serializer the file is `7371 / 344 / 7715` (one line more: the raw splice and the canonical inter-element gap differ by one). The measured value is stated here and in T-002; no criterion pins a root number, only `base == newlineCount` and `base + headroom = ceiling`.
**What this T0 plan drops from the T2 house form, and why each drop is safe.** No teaching task (the teaching moves inside T-001), no instruments task, no footprint task (T-001 carries the one footprint pin), no separate third task (the closing copy drive has no recordable red and shares T-002's final on-disk state). `DurableScope` is the spec's single `AffectedAreas` anchor, `M-SKILLS`, covered by `V-M-SKILLS` from the shipped verification document. The plan's baseline needles assert only what the bundle leaves unchanged; the pins, the old token, the old byte total and the absent `f266` are the bundle's flips and live in T-001/T-002 criteria, never in `BaselineAssertions`. The red-first signature keys sit inside the shipped budgets (`src/grace-cursor.ts`: `FIX_SIGNATURE_REPEAT_BUDGET` = 2, `FIX_DISTINCT_SIGNATURE_BUDGET` = 4): T-001 records `pin-guard` and `ceiling-guard` (one fail each); T-002 records `flush-invariant` and `record-row` (one fail each) plus the pass-only `post-close-drive` cycle, which counts toward neither budget — four distinct failing signatures, no repeated signature in any task's window. Every criterion in the authorizing spec is close-bound (it carries `CloseEvidence`), so no task lists `<Satisfies>`; a `Satisfies` of a close-bound `AC-*` is the shipped `change.close-evidence-and-satisfied` error. The last task ends at the live row, `--rewrite-roots` applied and the record validating clean; the close (`terminal`, `fold`, `--assertions final --run-commands`, a second terminal, `fold`, `review`, `gate verdict`, `gate apply`, `gate archive`, `apply`, the production `--retire`) is the authority's.
**BLOCKER — the approved spec's `AC-NO-OTHER-SRC` is unsatisfiable as written.** That `CloseEvidence` command excludes the three `src/` test files the spec knew about (`src/grace-status.test.ts`, `src/artifact/xml.test.ts`, `src/grace-context.test.ts`) but not the forced footprint file `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts`. Driven on the faithful copy, the command exits 1 naming exactly that one file, and `gate verdict --outcome pass` refuses (`CloseEvidence Command exited non-zero`) — so this bundle is uncloseable by construction. The spec's write-scope `Constraint` also never named the file. **The plan cannot repair an approved spec's command.** Recommended repair, per `D27`: supersede `C-TEST-TIMEOUT-CEILING-1-4985C820` with a successor that (a) names `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts` in the write-scope `Constraint` and in `AC-NO-OTHER-SRC`'s exclude list, and (b) carries this plan forward from the archived draft. This plan stays `status="draft"` and is not approvable until that successor exists; the authority's repair is not the executor's to make.
